# `preprocess_data/gastric_xenium/` — generated by the workflow

> The optional pre-extracted UNI grid is included in the single archive linked in the
> root README. This file documents the expected filenames and stage outputs.

All subdirectories ship **empty** except for a `.gitkeep`. Each is filled by one
pipeline stage; `uni/` is the only one you may need to populate from a download.

| Subdirectory  | Filled by                                    | Contents |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------|----------|
| `uni/`        | `prepare_gastric_xenium_uni.sh`, **or** the root archive | `superpixel_features.npy` `(1168, 2864, 1536)`, `superpixel_coordinates.npz`, `extraction_metadata.json` |
| `bcam_input/` | `prepare_gastric_xenium_bcam_input.sh`       | `gene_expression_normalized.npy` `(696313, 377)`, `uni2_features_per_cell.npy` `(696313, 1536)`, `cell_coords_standardized.npy`, `gene_names.npy`, `cell_ids.npy`, `superpixel_mapping.npy`, `preprocessing_metadata.json` |
| `inr_output/` | `reproduce_gastric_xenium_inr.sh`            | `inr_reconstructed_expression.npy` `(696313, 377)`, `inr_tucker_model.pth`, `coords_01.npy`, `coords_original.npy`, `training_curves.png`, `inr_training_info.json` |
| `bcam_output/`| `reproduce_gastric_xenium_bcam.sh`           | `fusion_latent_512.npy` `(696313, 512)`, `fusion_predicted_expression.npy`, `bcam_best.pth`, `bcam_final.pth`, `training_info.json` |
| `viz/`        | `reproduce_gastric_xenium_cluster.sh`        | `labels_fusion_K17.npy`, `domain_map_K17.{png,pdf}`, `clustering_K17_overview.png`, `cluster_summary.json` |

Expect roughly 30 GB in total for a full run (the UNI-2 grid alone is ~20.5 GB).
